lines.zh: 我弓着背小跑，脚爪刮着石头。
lines.en: I trot hunched, claws scraping the stone.

lines.zh: 我每走一步都要跳一下。
lines.en: I hop a little with every step.
I pick my way around the lava pool.

lines.zh: 我背上的石壳很沉，走不快。
lines.en: This stone shell is heavy and slows me.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁走，避开热浪。
lines.en: I keep to the wall, clear of the heat.

lines.zh: 我从石头上跳过去，落地很响。
lines.en: I hop across the rocks and land loudly.
I limp along; my legs are crooked.
I shuffle toward you without hiding.

lines.zh: 我踩在碎石上，石头被踩碎了。
lines.en: I walk on gravel and it crumbles.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩尾巴，扫起一层灰。
lines.en: I flick my tail and raise dust.

lines.zh: 我肩膀卡住，硬挤了出来。
lines.en: My shoulder jams, then I force through.
I shuffle over to the fire.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，背上的石头一动不动。
lines.en: I crouch, the stone on my back still.

lines.zh: 我的小眼睛在骨缝里转。
lines.en: My small eyes shift in their sockets.
I rest my chin on a claw.

lines.zh: 火光照在我石壳上，反出点点。
lines.en: Firelight glints off my stone shell.

lines.zh: 我抓了抓胳膊上的石片。
lines.en: I scratch the stone flakes on my arm.

lines.zh: 这里的空气烫嗓子，我不在乎。
lines.en: The air scalds my throat; I don't care.
I crouch by the fire and wait.
I stretch one leg out.

lines.zh: 我背上的石头裂了一小道。
lines.en: A small crack opens on my shell.

lines.zh: 我慢慢嚼着嘴里的一块石头。
lines.en: I chew slowly on a stone in my mouth.
I tip my face up; my teeth are whiter than you.
I look up at you; my neck is thick.
I show myself from behind a rock.
Your feet are on my shadow.

lines.zh: 我龇了龇牙，那牙不整齐。
lines.en: I bare my teeth; they don't line up.

lines.zh: 我举起一块石头，又放下。
lines.en: I raise a stone, then lower it.
You take a step; so do I.

lines.zh: 我背上那块石头能挡东西。
lines.en: The stone on my back stops things.
Come at me and I'll lunge.
I count the rubble by your feet.

lines.zh: 我背上的石头裂开一道。
lines.en: A crack opens in the stone on my back.
I tip and catch myself.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我没护住的地方。
lines.en: The blow found a spot I don't guard.
I growl, and it's muffled.
I retreat behind the fire.

lines.zh: 我一条腿跪下去，又撑起。
lines.en: One leg buckles; I push back up.

lines.zh: 石头碎屑从背上掉下来。
lines.en: Stone chips fall off my back.
I claw the dirt to steady myself.
I glare at you, teeth still bare.
I can still fight with this.
I don't eat stone, nor want it.
You set it on the rocks.
I sniff it and walk away.

lines.zh: 这点东西塞不住我的牙。
lines.en: That wouldn't wedge my teeth.
I grab a handful and throw it.
What I want is alive.
Keep it; I won't eat it.
The smell stings my nose.

lines.zh: 我踩了一脚，把它压进土里。
lines.en: I stamp it into the dirt.
I turn my head and walk back to the fire.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞到一块石头。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting stone.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，石壳响了一下。
lines.en: I give a step and my shell rings.
I tip over and catch myself.
I put a hand out and shove you.

lines.zh: 你被我背上的石头硌到了。
lines.en: You catch yourself on the stone on my back.
Sand and gravel kick up.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我矮了半头。
lines.en: We collide and I come off shorter.
I go around you toward the fire.
I can take that much.
I plant my feet and glare.

lines.zh: 我们用石壳互相碰了一下。
lines.en: We knock our stone shells together.
Her back is flatter than mine.
We crouch by the fire without moving.
She puts a claw on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们没有叫，只有石头响。
lines.en: We don't call out; only stone clicks.
Her legs are a little straighter than mine.
We warm ourselves at the same fire.
She rises and walks into the dark.

lines.zh: 这一片火边归我们两个。
lines.en: This fireside belongs to us both.
I keep crouching and watch her go.

lines.zh: 我用两只爪子把它捧起来。
lines.en: I take it in both claws.
It pulls my arms down.

lines.zh: 我咬了一下，牙齿缺了口。
lines.en: I bite it and chip a tooth.
I tuck it against my stone shell.

lines.zh: 我爪子上全是灰，抓不住。
lines.en: My claws are all dust; I cannot grip.

lines.zh: 我把它扔到身后，没回头。
lines.en: I throw it behind me without looking.

lines.zh: 我扛在背上，走两步就歪。
lines.en: I shoulder it and lurch after two steps.

lines.zh: 我拿着它走了两步就丢了。
lines.en: I carry it two steps and drop it.
I raise it up as a shield.
This one I'm not giving to anyone.
You moved, and I saw.
I hunch the stone on my back down.
I circle around from the far side of the fire.
You're too close to my fire.
I bare my teeth and drool.
I know every path around here.
You're standing in the light; I can find you.
I don't like shouting; it's too loud.
The moment you retreat, I follow.
I'm on my way — quickly.

lines.zh: 我背上的石头给不了你掩护。
lines.en: The stone on my back won't cover you.
I know you want to strike from above.
I hop one step your way.
Don't think of hiding behind the rocks.
I follow you step by step.

lines.zh: 你跳上高台，我爬不上去。
lines.en: You climb a ledge I can't reach.
I circle the base and wait.
I throw a stone at your feet.
You block it; ash falls on your hand.

lines.zh: 我贴着石头，一点点靠近。
lines.en: I keep to the stone and close in.
This ring by the fire is our field.
You back to the lava; no way left.
I raise a hand; my knuckles crack.
You look for a way out; I don't wait.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁绕到你侧后。
lines.en: I hug the rock wall around to your flank.

lines.zh: 我把一块石头举过头顶。
lines.en: I raise a stone overhead.
It comes down and breaks in two.
The chips get in your eyes.
I use the moment to close in.
Now I'm right in front of you.
I swing a claw.

lines.zh: 你的护甲被砸得凹下去。
lines.en: Your armor dents.
I ram you with the stone on my shoulder.
I bite down on your boot.
Your kick sends me into the rock wall.

lines.zh: 这一下落在石头上，火星四溅。
lines.en: It lands on stone and sparks fly.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，整个人压下去。
lines.en: I leap and come down with all of me.
You pull back and I hit the ground.

lines.zh: 我拽住你的裤腿往下拖。
lines.en: I grab your trouser leg and pull down.
You raise a guard; I bite the wrist.
I leap, and my claws already have hold.

lines.zh: 我的牙在你身上留了一排印。
lines.en: My teeth leave a row of marks.

lines.zh: 我的石头脑门磕在你腿上。
lines.en: My stone brow cracks against your leg.
I catch your belt and pull down.
You hit the stone loudly.
I leap onto your back and press.
The rubble shifts first, then me.
Ash still clings to my shell.
The firelight dances on my stone shell.
I sniff the air first.
I crouch and look for food.
The ground is all broken stone.
I test my legs and find my footing.
I head for the fire.
There's something alive here.
I grind my teeth twice.
I'm looking for something to smash.
I've learned the paths here.

lines.zh: 火太近了，我的石壳在响。
lines.en: The fire's too close; my shell crackles.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，砸进碎石堆里。
lines.en: I fall and land in the gravel.
Water floods in; I clutch the rock edge.

lines.zh: 冲击把我身上的石片掀掉了。
lines.en: The blast strips flakes off me.

lines.zh: 一根细东西扎进我的肩。
lines.en: Something thin sticks in my shoulder.
The light burns my eyes.

lines.zh: 饿得没力气，我趴在石头上。
lines.en: Too hungry to move, I lie on the stone.

lines.zh: 雷落在石壳上，我浑身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning hits my shell and I convulse.

lines.zh: 四周没有石头，我抓不到东西。
lines.en: No stone anywhere; I can't grab hold.
